# mockingbird_scenario (Resource)

A named scenario of a mock: extra LLM instructions, a forced status, latency, forced body fields or chaos, applied when a caller sends `X-Mockingbird-Scenario: <name>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Selected per call with the header `X-Mockingbird-Scenario: card-declined`.
resource "mockingbird_scenario" "card_declined" {
  mock         = mockingbird_mock.stripe.name
  name         = "card-declined"
  instructions = "The card is declined for insufficient funds."
  status       = 402
  operations   = ["PostPaymentIntents", "PostPaymentIntentsIntentConfirm"]
  set = jsonencode({
    error = { code = "card_declined", decline_code = "insufficient_funds" }
  })
}

resource "mockingbird_scenario" "slow" {
  mock       = mockingbird_mock.stripe.name
  name       = "slow"
  latency_ms = 3000
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `mock` (String) Name of the mock.
- `name` (String) Scenario name, 1–128 characters of `[A-Za-z0-9._-]`.

### Optional

- `chaos` (Attributes) Fault injection. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--chaos))
- `instructions` (String) Extra instructions for the LLM, e.g. `The card is declined for insufficient funds.`
- `latency_ms` (Number) Added latency in milliseconds.
- `operation_instructions` (Map of String) Instructions replacing `instructions` for one operation, by operation id.
- `operations` (List of String) Operation ids the scenario applies to; unset means all.
- `set` (String) A JSON object of fields forced into the response body, e.g. `jsonencode({ status = "failed" })`.
- `status` (Number) Forced response status, 100–599. A non-5xx status must be declared by an operation the scenario applies to.
- `stream_item_interval_ms` (Number) Pause between streamed items in milliseconds (at most 30000).
- `stream_items` (Number) Items per streamed response (1–10000).
- `workspace` (String) Workspace of the resource. Defaults to the provider's `workspace`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier, `<workspace>/<mock>/<name>`; also the import ID.

<a id="nestedatt--chaos"></a>
### Nested Schema for `chaos`

Optional:

- `drop_stream_rate` (Number) Probability (0–1) that a streamed response is cut short.
- `error_rate` (Number) Probability (0–1) that a call answers with an injected error.
- `latency_jitter` (Attributes) Uniformly random added latency. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--chaos--latency_jitter))

<a id="nestedatt--chaos--latency_jitter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `chaos.latency_jitter`

Required:

- `max_ms` (Number) At most 30000 and at least `min_ms`.
- `min_ms` (Number)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# A scenario is imported as <workspace>/<mock>/<name>.
terraform import mockingbird_scenario.card_declined default/stripe/card-declined
```
